scope: Read-only audit of mapping, sampled physical columns, numerical primal/dual identities, and one full exact pricing call. Does not certify source obstruction, physical frame, exact mixture membership, or whole optimization trace.

mathematical_review.primal_dual: min ||F*lambda-b||_1, lambda>=0,sum(lambda)=1; dual max c*b-gamma with c*F_j<=gamma, |c_i|<=1.
mathematical_review.active_pruning: Deleting exact-zero nonbasic columns preserves an optimal primal and its feasible dual; implementation uses numerical zero tolerances and final source cuts still require exact global pricing.
mathematical_review.diagnosis: No mapping/sign/pruning bug found; large global pricing gaps are compatible with unstable extreme box-duals on restricted column sets.
mathematical_review.wolfe_gate: For f(x)=0.5*(x-b)^T D*(x-b), c=D*(b-x); maximize c*phi. Wolfe gap=h(c)-c*x; separating target gap=c*b-h(c). They are distinct.
mathematical_review.wolfe_safeguards: Feasible normalized nonnegative start, decreasing minor-cycle objective, mass/nonnegativity checks, corral stationarity, rank-loss stop, true-gradient witness comparisons, and explicit quantization-error bound before convergence claims.
